summary: PASS — Biometric/fingerprint unlock fix verified. All 3 modified files (appLock.ts, AppLockGate.tsx, profile.tsx) lint clean with zero errors. Static analysis confirms all specified contract requirements: BiometricResult discriminated union, disableDeviceFallback:false, fallbackLabel/cancelLabel/promptMessage, supportedAuthenticationTypesAsync usage, hasFingerprint/hasFace booleans, error code coverage in biometricErrorMessage (user_cancel, lockout, not_enrolled, not_available, authentication_failed + more). AppLockGate.tsx correctly uses autoTriggeredRef guard, adaptive button labels, bioBusy 'Waiting for scan…', and bioErr <Text testID='lock-bio-error'>. profile.tsx line 186 correctly uses `if (okBio.success)`. UI smoke test: Guest login → Profile → App Lock toggle → 'Set App Lock PIN' modal → enter 1234 → 'Confirm PIN' modal all render cleanly with ZERO console/pageerror events and no red-screen. No occurrence of 'biometricPrompt is not a function', 'okBio is not a function', or 'cannot read property success of undefined'. Web preview cannot exercise actual biometric hardware (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: appLock.ts biometricPrompt correctly narrows LocalAuthentication result via cast `(res as {error?:string;warning?:string}).error` — clean typing.
AppLockGate: autoTriggeredRef is reset inside maybeLock() before setLocked(true), which is the correct order to guarantee the auto-trigger effect fires exactly once per lock cycle.

Info (not a regression): Confirming PIN on the WEB preview shows 'Failed to save PIN. Try again.' — this is expo-secure-store's known web limitation (no native secure keystore in the browser). It is unrelated to the biometric fix under review and will function normally on iOS/Android device builds. No action required for this bug ticket.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Biometric fix scope-complete. If future PIN-related bugs are reported, note that expo-secure-store on web preview always fails to persist — must be validated on Expo Go / native build. Testids available on lock screen: app-lock-screen, lock-biometric, lock-bio-error, lock-backspace, lock-digit-{0..9}.
rca_of_issue: Original bug 'Fingerprint se unlock nahi ho raha hai' RCAs: (1) biometricPrompt() returned a plain boolean while some callers were treating truthy object as success — after refactor caller used `if (okBio.success)` — fixed. (2) `disableDeviceFallback:true` caused silent auth sheet dismissal on Xiaomi/OnePlus/Realme when the user hadn't set a device lock — flipped to false so Android shows native fallback and our own PIN pad is used. (3) Auto-trigger fired on every re-render creating spam / lockouts — now gated by autoTriggeredRef, one-shot per lock cycle. (4) No error visibility for the user on failure — now surfaced via biometricErrorMessage() below the button. All four root causes addressed and verified via static analysis + lint + UI smoke test.
